spec_match.rationale: Probes the state model's four sharpest rules straight from the IDL and explainer: checked reflects no content attribute; defaultChecked ↔ defaultchecked; checkable's ReflectOnly single/multiple with invalid→multiple; and checkedness requiring a checkable fieldset ancestor inside a menulist.

interactive.rationale: Run button re-executes all probes against freshly constructed elements; the manual menuitemradio/menuitemcheckbox panel is fully clickable with a state ledger.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises reflection probes plus the manual equivalent; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Three-way support handling (full / early-iteration with live checked but no groups / absent) with distinct honest status wording for each; invalid checkable keyword normalisation probed explicitly.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5206029088063488 and the explainer's checkable-menu-items section backing each rule.

conformance.rationale: The suite's checked-not-reflected, defaultchecked-reflected, checkable-normalisation and checkable-ancestor assertions are these probes distilled.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP: bare run reported every rule row absent honestly while the manual panel's radio exclusivity ([false,true,false]) and checkbox independence ([false,true,true]) were driven and ledgered; flag run confirmed the early-iteration path (live checked IDL present, group semantics absent) with the corrected three-way status. Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Mock menu on ivory with stone hover, emerald/rose verdicts, focus outlines --accent-blue; buttons override background AND color; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Manual items carry role=menuitemradio/menuitemcheckbox with live aria-checked (the harness asserted the values); check marks are aria-hidden with state in aria-checked; ledger role=log aria-live; probe table has caption and scoped headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two-column grid collapses under 760px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Run the group-semantics probes on a checkable-capable build
openQuestions.detail: Rows 3–4 (keyword normalisation, ancestor requirement) have never executed against a real surface here — no available build ships fieldset.checkable. Verify on a current dev-trial build, including the checked event ordering after click.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Checkable menu items expose state via aria-checked with visual marks decorative.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: aria-checked is the source of truth; marks aria-hidden; ledger announces transitions.

guidanceConsulted.query: reflection content attribute vs idl state probes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Distinguish reflected attributes from live IDL state when teaching element APIs.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The reflection asymmetry IS the lesson; each probe names which side it tests.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the manual pattern's exclusive/independent state machines were driven with asserted aria-checked outcomes on both viewports, and the IDL probes reported the absent/early surface honestly — the group-semantics rows await a checkable-capable build, recorded as the open question.
